data.narrative:
Aurelius Systems is a Seed-stage defense and security company that has raised $10M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 peers (2 public, 8 private) in the Defense & Security sector, including same-stage and adjacent-stage companies such as UFORCE, Singularity, and NODA AI.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression modeling uses the $10M raised as a proxy for current valuation and applies a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier to the next financing stage, implying a $25M valuation. Peer-median analysis examines three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables with valuations ranging from $125M to $1.0B; the median across this set is $400M. The wide dispersion reflects heterogeneity in company maturity and investor appetite within the defense tech space.

These two methods triangulate to a range of $21M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $212M. The substantial gap between stage-progression and peer-median results reflects uncertainty about which comparables are most relevant to Aurelius at this early stage. Key sensitivities include the calibration of the stage-up multiplier, the selection and weighting of peer companies, and whether the current defense sector momentum will persist through the next funding round. Additional founder track record and product-market fit indicators would help narrow this range materially.
